alexcrichton opened PR #14381 from alexcrichton:different-dirent-d-type-fallback to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit adjusts a fallback that happens when reading a directory and reporting the names/file-types of what's contained. Previously illumos would do a separate syscall to find the file type since the dirent doesn't have the information and other platforms would use the d_type field. Turns out though that apparently a number of filesystems also don't fill in d_type so it's not uncommon to run into this. The WASI API, subjectively to me at least, is a best-effort way of letting the guest know the information that the host already has, so there's no need to be 100% accurate. Instead this changes the illumos syscall fallback to just always using the Unknown file type which will also be consistent with what various filesystems on other Unix systems would report anyway too.
